verdicts.summary: Lean has a stronger form of it. The paper asserts moment equality at the single radius X_rep and field equality (Ẽ, Ũ) = (E, U) on X ≥ X_rep. Lean states both on the whole closed range: rows_outside and the clause at ModulatedProfileJetRates.lean:387 give profileRows R (X, η) = profileRows Q (X, η) for every X ≥ the right endpoint of the repair patch, and fields_outside gives f and U equality on the entire complement of the open modulation interval, so in particular at X_rep itself and to its left of the patch as well. Each implies the paper's clause by instantiating X := X_rep (first clause) or restricting to X ≥ X_rep (second). The recovery is in that direction only: the paper derives the X > X_rep moment equality from the X = X_rep equality plus the field equality by integrating the transport relation outward, while Lean proves the integrated form directly. Recorded here as stronger, not as a defect. One encoding note, verified: the structure field that literally carries this property, ModulatedProfileAssembly.Witness.restored (:443), is a projection and does not appear in the declaration index, so the indexed consequences rows_outside / fields_outside / exterior_pressure are cited in its place; I read the field at its source line.
